description: Diagnose ANY EVM JSON-RPC endpoint (ours or anyone's). With {url} only: checks chain identity, block height, and archive capability with latency. With {url, method, params}: performs that exact JSON-RPC call and returns the result or error.

method.description: Optional JSON-RPC method to call, e.g. 'eth_chainId'.

params.description: Optional params array for the method call.

url.description: The http(s) RPC endpoint URL to probe.

name: probe_endpoint
